summary_en: Oxygen is a chemical element with symbol O and atomic number 8. It is a member of the chalcogen group on the periodic table and is a highly reactive nonmetal and oxidizing agent that readily forms compounds (notably oxides) with most elements. By mass, oxygen is the third-most abundant element in the universe, after hydrogen and helium.
summary_ko: Oxygen은(는) 이원자 비금속 원소로, 의료용 산소 등에 쓰이는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
